scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @claudio/web build && pnpm --filter @claudio/api bundle && pnpm run build && electron . --dev --no-sandbox
scripts.package:stage: mkdir -p dist/package && node ../api/scripts/server-bundle.mjs --shell-json dist/package/shell.json && install -m 0644 ../../packaging/apt/claudio-archive-keyring.gpg dist/package/claudio-archive-keyring.gpg && install -m 0644 build/linux/claudio-update.service build/linux/50-claudio-update.rules build/linux/claudio.pref dist/package/ && install -m 0755 build/linux/claudio-update dist/package/claudio-update
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm --filter @claudio/web build && pnpm --filter @claudio/api bundle && pnpm run build && pnpm run package:stage && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
